verdict.rationale: Docusaurus content is authored as local MDX/Markdown files, with CommonMark available as an opt-in. It builds them into static HTML in a `build` directory you can host anywhere, and users report migrating away from it, so the data stays in portable formats. However, there is no documented export or migration feature, and MDX content with embedded React components is only partly portable. Missing for 10: a documented export/data-portability workflow, guidance on converting MDX/JSX-embedded content to plain open formats, and independent hands-on evidence of a lossless move to another tool.
